endCard.title: Axial Plenum Fan

pillars.title: The Digital Twin of Analytical Intelligence
pillars.intro: Our process begins not with a product, but with problem analysis. For NOVVES, engineering means more than selecting a fan — it means mathematically predicting the behavior of smoke and heat within a structure.

items.label: CFD Simulations
items.desc: We simulate fire scenarios in a digital environment, proving system performance before installation.

items.label: Precision Calculations
items.desc: With building-specific airflow and pressurization calculations, we avoid redundant engineering costs and achieve optimum efficiency.

items.label: Project-Focused Approach
items.desc: We manufacture products fully compliant with technical specifications.

pillars.title: Craftsmanship Beyond Standards
pillars.intro: Every data point approved during the design phase transforms into physical performance at our manufacturing facilities. By combining our engineering ecosystem with modern production technologies, we reduce the margin of error to zero.

items.label: Certified Performance
items.desc: Every fan and damper we manufacture is tested by accredited laboratories to international fire resistance standards such as EN 12101-3.

items.label: Precision Manufacturing
items.desc: From laser cutting to dynamic balance testing, we work with millimetric tolerances at every stage.

items.label: Sustainable Materials
items.desc: We maximize system lifecycle using durable, corrosion-resistant materials with high energy efficiency.

pillars.title: Flawless On-Site Performance
pillars.intro: The best product saves lives only when properly integrated. The final link in our innovation chain is ensuring the system works in seamless harmony with the building's infrastructure.

items.label: Site Supervision
items.desc: We provide technical guidance during installation to ensure proper system positioning as designed.

items.label: Commissioning
items.desc: Through cold and hot smoke tests, we verify the system's response time and extraction capacity on site.

items.label: Smart Automation Integration
items.desc: We guarantee synchronization of jet fans and dampers with fire detection systems within milliseconds.

video.title: Brand Introduction Video
video.desc: Get to know NOVVES's manufacturing facilities, engineering approach, and project experience up close.

items.a: NOVVES provides smoke extraction, comfort ventilation, and industrial air management solutions across a wide range of sectors including parking garages, tunnels, shopping malls, hospitals, hotels, industrial facilities, greenhouses, power plants, and residential buildings.

items.q: Which standards do your products comply with?
items.a: Our products are manufactured in compliance with EN 12101-3, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, CE, and ATEX standards, and are tested in accredited laboratories.

items.q: Do you provide CFD analysis services?
items.a: Yes, we perform 3D CFD simulations for each project to analyze smoke propagation, temperature, CO concentration, and visibility distance, optimizing jet fan placement.
We provide comprehensive after-sales support including commissioning, periodic maintenance, spare parts supply, and 24/7 technical service.
